THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

THE SCENE

Your class is holding a practice court case. You are a lawyer. In your paper for the judge, you use a quote from an old book. The judge will not accept the quote without a full footnote. A footnote is a short note at the bottom of a page. It tells where a quote came from. You need four facts for the footnote. Four people each can help you.

THE HISTORY

Your quote is from Ibn Khaldun, a writer from Tunis, in North Africa. In 1377 he wrote a famous book called the Muqaddimah. He said history writers must check every story. A footnote lets readers check your story too.
